messages.author: f4306cc1076cb165
messages.subject: LODs for significant epistasis
parts:
Hi

I want to asky you about which of two LOD scores I should take in
consideration inorder to have significant epistatic interataction.

According to Karl
"Mfv1(j, k) is the log10 likelihood ratio comparing the full model
with QTL on chromosomes
j and k to the single-QTL model, with a single QTL on either
chromosome j or k. Thus, it
indicates evidence for a second QTL, allowing for the possibility of
epistasis."

so do I have to take LOD.full and LOD.fv above threshold for epistatic
interaction or LOD.full and LOD.int above threshold for evidance of
epistasis.

Thanks

s

> summary(out2, alpha=c(0.05,0.20) )
Control.t1 (1000 permutations)
full fv1 int add av1
5% 6.0 4.64 4.07 4.82 2.85
20% 5.3 3.94 3.36 4.10 2.25

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] LODs for significant epistasis
parts:
I look for LOD.full and LOD.fv1 to each be above their thresholds, and then for LOD.int to also be large. But others may disagree. In particular, you might just look for LOD.int to be above its threshold.

karl
